messages:
Aria (CS): Quick heads up - Northlight Analytics requested EU + APAC pilot allowlists and a temporary rate lift for an investor press demo. They want a 2h burst window starting 2026-04-01T11:00Z. Ticket CS-4988 opened.
Marcus (CS Manager): Flagging renewal risk: demo tied to upcoming renewal conversation. If onboarding stumbles theyll likely ask for credits/terms. Keep ops tight and capture metrics.
Aria (CS): IPs & config from Northlight: 
```
# Northlight partner proxies
54.37.200.0/24
54.37.201.88
54.37.202.0/25
expected_peak_qps=350
baseline_qps=25
burst_window=2h
auto_revoke=48h
mTLS_client_cn=nl-prod
```
Ben (NetOps): We can provision per-region ACLs (eu-edge-acl-nl, apac-edge-acl-nl). Need CA bundle + confirmation that those IPs are egressing from the listed proxies. I'll prepare CHG-9487. Staging allowlists can be applied in ~15m for smoke.
Leah (Support): Tentative change: CHG-9487. Prod window 2026-04-01 10:30-11:15 UTC (low traffic). ETA ~30-45m to apply ACLs + validation. Autorevoke job = 48h. Alert thresholds: page oncall if QPS > 500 or error_rate > 3%.
change-bot: CHG-9487 created and scheduled for 2026-04-01T10:30:00Z by Leah. Reminder set for 1h prior.
Aria (CS): Northlight uploaded CA bundle + CSR link (secure ticket). Uploaded now to CS-4988.
Ben (NetOps): Staging ACLs applied: eu-staging-acl-nl, apac-staging-acl-nl. Smoke test: TLS handshake OK, 200 responses, sample p50=95ms.
Marcus (CS Manager): Excellent. Capture pilot metrics for the renewal packet and mark this as high priority. Add tag 'pilot_success' to CS-4988 if green.
Leah (Support): Monitoring plan: check every 15m for first 2h, then hourly. Escalate to oncall if error_rate > 3% or p95_latency > 350ms. Will post summaries in thread.
Aria (CS): Also recommending reserved capacity if sustained QPS > 300 for 24h. Note for renewal review.
Ben (NetOps): Prod change executed. ACL names: eu-prod-acl-nl, apac-prod-acl-nl. Auto-revoke job id=ar-7759. Change log snippet: 
```
apply-acl eu-prod-acl-nl 54.37.200.0/24
apply-acl apac-prod-acl-nl 54.37.201.88
set-autorevoke ar-7759 48h
```
change-bot: CHG-9487 completed by Leah at 2026-04-01T10:45:00Z.
Leah (Support): Initial 2h summary: peak_qps=372, error_rate=0.6%, p95_latency=210ms. No escalation needed. Will compile post-pilot report Monday and drop into CS-4988.
Marcus (CS Manager): Thanks team. Aria - please add renewal note and schedule a follow-up check-in next week with Northlight. :thumbsup:
